Machines, robots, sensors, and mobile equipment need reliable communication to work together in real time. At the same time, production environments must become more flexible, scalable, and easier to reconfigure. This is where 5G Mobile Private Networks (MPN) can make a real difference. A private 5G network provides dedicated wireless connectivity for an industrial environment, with controlled access through SIM or eSIM profiles. It creates a secure foundation for connecting machines, robots, sensors, and mobile equipment across the production environment. What are the benefits for industrial automation? Reliable connectivity for moving equipment AGVs, AMRs, mobile workstations, and other equipment need continuous connectivity as they move around a production facility. Traditional Wi-Fi can experience coverage gaps, interference, and disruptions during handovers between access points. Kontron's 5G MPN is designed to provide wide coverage and seamless mobility, helping maintain stable connections across large industrial environments. Fewer access points and less cabling A wider coverage area can reduce the need for multiple Wi-Fi access points and repeaters. 5G can also replace parts of fixed network infrastructure where mobility and flexibility are important. They offer flexibility, intuitive navigation, and sleek user experiences. But in demanding environments, relying on touch alone is not always the best solution. Hybrid HMI solutions, like the Aplex ABOS-9 Panel PC , combine the advantages of touchscreen technology with the practical benefits of tactile controls creates a more reliable and user-friendly operator experience. Benefits of physical buttons in HMI applications Physical controls continue to offer major advantages in environments where usability and reliability are critical. Tactile Feedback Improves Accuracy One of the biggest benefits of physical buttons is tactile feedback. Operators can feel when a button has been pressed, reducing uncertainty and improving confidence during operation. This becomes especially important in safety-critical applications where quick reactions matter. Better Usability with Gloves In many industrial environments, gloves are mandatory. Even if there is a wide range of touch screen solutions that are made to work with gloves, they still might to detect input accurately, while physical buttons remain easy to use regardless of protective equipment. Scalable architecture provides the flexibility to meet evolving application requirements. The Limitations of fixed architectures Traditional industrial computers with fixed architectures can become difficult and costly to upgrade as automation systems evolve. Modern industrial applications increasingly require higher processing performance, AI capabilities, image processing, advanced I/O and integration with multiple devices. A system designed only for today’s requirements may quickly become limited as these demands grow. Limited expansion slots, restricted chassis space and hardware compatibility can make it difficult to add GPUs, communication cards, storage, I/O modules or other expansion options. This can be particularly challenging in industrial automation , machine vision and scalable embedded systems, where applications often need to adapt to new processes, technologies and performance requirements. For example, an automation system may initially require basic control and data processing, but later need AI-based inspection, real-time image analysis, additional sensors or increased connectivity.
